This [[Gender/Legends|female]] green-skinned '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]''' was [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] dancer before [[Nima'tar]], [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. During a performance for Jabba, he started pulling on her chain, dragging her towards him; she struggled with her end of the leash in protest. Jabba, angered by her defiance, triggered the trapdoor beneath her. She dropped into the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit below where she was [[Death/Legends|eaten alive]] by the crime lord's [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|pet]].
